about.hero_body: A swimwear brand born from a single moment. Shaped by Atlantic waves and the light that changed everything.
about.vision_p1: Mar del Plata, Atlantic coast. No plan, no concept. Just water, horizon and that one feeling words can barely hold: when everything falls into place and all you want is to be right there.
about.vision_p2: The swimsuit I was wearing didn't belong. Too stiff, too loud, too far from what that moment called for. Like a wrong note in a perfect song.
about.vision_p3_pre: On the way back, the idea was there:
about.vision_p3_em: swimwear that feels the way this place sounded.
about.promise_title: Feeling good is not a feature.
about.promise_p1: Anything we wouldn't wear into the water ourselves — with full conviction — has no place here. No compromise, no almost. Every bikini is tested against sun, salt and chlorine until it truly feels right.
about.promise_p2_pre: We work with specialists who know swimwear fabrics inside out. Not gut feeling versus expertise, but both in tune. The result: pieces
about.card1_body: Every bikini and every swimsuit passes through our own hands first. Anything that doesn't feel truly convincing never makes it into the range. That stance is non-negotiable.
about.card2_body: We work with manufacturers for whom quality is no marketing promise. Fabrics that stand up to salt, chlorine and sun. Seams that hold. Cuts that stay in place — in the water and on the beach.
about.card3_body: We are based in Switzerland and see ourselves as your direct point of contact. Questions, concerns, feedback: always personal, never routed through detours. No automated processes, no endless waiting.
